canonical_project: ACE / STP Cabo submarine cable landing station (Sao Tome)
owner: STP Cabo (PPP/SPV; CST holds 74.5%) / ACE consortium
notes: Connectivity record - NOT a datacenter. ACE cable RFS Dec 2012 with Sao Tome and Principe as landing station (ACE official page; Wikipedia; geocables); STP Cabo manages the landing station and national capacity share; STP switched from satellite to ACE in 2012 (World Bank P177158). Landing station in Sao Tome (Agua Grande). No colocation/hosting/server evidence at the station, so no DC facility record per methodology.
